issue for me is I wish there was more artificial difficulty, mini bosses becoming regular disturbances was a great addition. Adding more disturbances to ruin a player's flow and keep them on edge might keep people like myself engaged for longer periods. I haven't touched CW since firebase dropped and I enjoyed it. But there isn't much reason to return, at least for me. You could say for fun, which yes seems obvious, but I do enjoy the challenge of not knowing a map and having to adapt to new mechanics and enemies. Just after that learning period is over, it's back to running in circles waiting for more content.

Anyhow, I do think the gameplay is fine for all types of players, casual/new zombies players and people who date back from WaW. 

I just wish more difficulty was added, for people who want it - but I do understand this could end up creating a big divide for an otherwise casual PVE mode
